name: Torikori
source:
The mother of [url=/c37793]Oshtor[/url] and [url=/c37792]Nekone[/url], she lives by herself on the outskirts of Ennakamuy. After her husband died, she raised [url=/c37793]Oshtor[/url] and [url=/c37792]Nekone[/url] as a single mother.
Kind and gentle, she is a loving mother, but she has a frail constitution, and her eyes have gotten worse over the years. As a result, she lives a fairly quiet life in her home.
